description: align-items, align-self and align-content on a flex container: a stretched row, a centred one with a per-item override, an end-aligned one, and a wrapped container whose lines are centred in a declared height. Authored here rather than ported: the reference engine implements these properties, but this port's corpus carries no Expectation for them.
visual_assertions: In the first row both boxes are the same height: the short one is stretched to the tall one.
In the second row the short box is its own height and vertically centred against the tall one, while the box marked Selfstart sits at the top of the row.
In the third row the short box sits at the foot of the row.
The wrapped container holds two lines of two boxes, and the pair of lines is centred vertically in the bordered container with space above and below.
